Overview

I build websites for businesses that need pages to do a job: bring in customers. That means a clear offer on the first screen, the details visitors actually look for - prices, hours, how to book or order - and one obvious next step on every page.

So far that is four live sites: a sample site for a coffee shop, a rebuilt portfolio for a professor and author, and two sites for The Nanee, a boutique hotel in Bhaktapur, Nepal. New projects start at $500. Two slots are open below.

    About

    I'm a mechanical engineering student at UW Tacoma who builds websites for businesses. I'm based in Tacoma, WA.

    Engineering school is where I learn how things are put together - structures, materials, how a design holds up under real use. Website work is the same habit pointed at a different problem: a page has a job to do, and it either does it or it doesn't.

    The sites I have built so far are a sample site for a coffee shop, a rebuilt portfolio for a professor and author, and two sites for The Nanee, a boutique hotel in Bhaktapur, Nepal. Each one started from what the business needed a visitor to do, and was built out from there.

    What I do

    • Website design and build. Complete sites for businesses, from the first layout to the finished page.
    • Clear pages that sell. The offer up front, real prices and details on the page, and one obvious next step for the visitor.
    • Built for phones and computers. Every page is laid out to work on a small screen first, where most visitors arrive.
    • Rebuilds. Existing sites reworked so they read clearly and load fast.
